What is Binance Convert Limit Order?"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"A Binance Convert Limit Order is a feature that allows users to set a specific target price at which they want to convert one cryptocurrency to another. Unlike the instant order type, a Convert Limit Order is triggered when the Convert quote price reaches your specified limit price before executing the conversion."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Key Features:"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"ul","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Set Target Price: You specify the price at which you want to convert your crypto."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Automatic Execution: The conversion happens automatically once the Convert quote price hits your limit price."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Simplified Trading: Combines the ease of Binance Convert with the price control of limit orders."}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"For example:"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If you want to convert BTC to USDC but only when BTC reaches a certain price, you can place a Binance Convert Limit Order at that price. The conversion will execute automatically once BTC hits your target price without constantly monitoring the market."},{"node":"element","tag":"br"},{"node":"text","text":" "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"2. What happens to my asset when I place a limit order?"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"In this new feature, you can choose whether to allow your order assets to be placed in Earn Flexible Products to generate rewards while waiting for the limit order execution. There are two possible scenarios:"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Scenario 1: You choose to Earn with Simple Earn Flexible Products"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"The assets for your limit order will be placed in Simple Earn Flexible Products, so they can generate rewards while waiting for the order to execute, subject to the Simple Earn Flexible Product personal subscription quota."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If the subscription to Simple Earn Flexible Products fails, your limit order will not be created, and you will see this error message:"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"“Your limit order was not placed successfully. Please try again after ensuring you have sufficient funds in your Spot or Funding wallet or by choosing not to earn rewards.”"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"figure","attr":{"class":["image","image_resized"],"style":"width:22.08%;"},"child":[{"node":"element","tag":"img","attr":{"src":"https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202510/e3a763a82763285b79a57d1fad88ae1c.png"}}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If the subscription is successful, your limit order will be created successfully, and your funds will remain in Simple Earn Flexible Products until the order is executed or until you separately redeem the assets (e.g. due to cancellation or expiry of the order). In the case where the redemption failed, "},{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"your limit order will not be executed and Binance is not liable for unexecuted orders. "}]},{"node":"text","text":"You may refer to Question #7 for more details on your asset destination."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"*Please note: Daily redemption limits apply. Redemption of Simple Earn Flexible Assets may be delayed in exceptional circumstances, which may include without limitation, extreme market volatility, network outages and delays, validator or protocol failure, a significant number of simultaneous instructions to Redeem from other Binance users, or other unanticipated events."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Scenario 2: You do not choose to Earn with Simple Earn Flexible Product "}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"The assets for your limit order will be frozen in your Spot Account until the order is executed. In this case, your funds will not generate rewards."},{"node":"element","tag":"br"},{"node":"text","text":" "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"3. How do I subscribe to this feature?"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"To subscribe to this feature, check the box on the Convert Limit Preview page and confirm the order. Your limit order is placed, and the asset will be enrolled in Flexible Products while waiting to be filled."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"figure","attr":{"class":["image","image_resized"],"style":"width:624px;"},"child":[{"node":"element","tag":"img","attr":{"src":"https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202510/c0502f82c4d1d3f4820bf7f80a72c8eb.png"}}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Please note:"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"ul","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"There is a chance that your order may not be filled even if the limit price is reached, due to market conditions."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Your limit order will not be executed if the assets are not immediately available or redeemed from the Simple Earn Flexible Product."},{"node":"element","tag":"br"},{"node":"text","text":" "}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"*Please note: Daily redemption limits apply. Redemption of Simple Earn Flexible Assets may be delayed in exceptional circumstances, which may include without limitation, extreme market volatility, network outages and delays, validator or protocol failure, a significant number of simultaneous instructions to Redeem from other Binance users, or other unanticipated events."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"4. Why do I not see this option in my Convert Limit Order Page?"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Due to compliance regulation, your region/country might not be eligible for Earn Flexible Products, hence this feature may not be available to you. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"5. What happens to my order if the price did not meet my Limit price? "}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If the quote price never reaches your limit price, the order remains open and your asset stays untouched in your Simple Earn Flexible Product, generating rewards."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"You can cancel the Convert Limit Order anytime before it gets accepted by Binance, and your asset will remain fully redeemable in your Earn account. Please note that cancellation of the Convert Limit Order does not of itself trigger redemption from Simple Earn and you would need to separately redeem. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"6. What happens to my order if I have redeemed the assets from my Earn Flexible Product beforehand? "}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If an asset has been redeemed or is unavailable when limit order is triggered, the system will automatically cancel the order. No limit order will be executed in this case."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"7. I placed and later cancelled a limit order; where is my asset?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"After subscribing to Simple Earn Flexible Products, your assets stay in your Earn Account while the limit order executes. If you cancel or the order expires, assets remain in your Earn Account - Simple Earn Flexible Products. Please note that cancellation of the Convert Limit Order does not of itself trigger redemption from Simple Earn and you would need to separately redeem. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If the limit order fails to execute after successful redemption from Simple Earn Flexible Products, assets will be returned to your Spot Account."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"8. Why did my limit order not fill even though the market price has met my price settings? "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Please note that limit-mode order execution is subject to the quoted price, your specified limit price, market depth and liquidity, and thus it may not always get executed and filled even if the market price momentarily reaches or crosses your limit price."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":" "}]}]}
